name: Xile
source:
The self-styled queen and leader of the Marleybone Irregulars.

Survived an attempt on her life, ordered by [url=/c173791]Alilph Skeda[/url]. The pirate queen subsequently ordered the death of Skeda and put a price on his head.

[In-Game Description]
